profile.headline: Customer Support Engineer at Paymenthub
profile.geoLocationName: Los Angeles County, California, United States
profile.summary:
I come from a background that includes software development, QA automation, and data analysis to solve from simple to complex business problems. By combining development experience with AI tools , I focus on building stable product features, eliminating manual overhead, and deliver a multi faceted approach to my work.
Core Capabilities:
Software Development: Writing clean, functional code focused on end-world utility.
QA Automation: Designing automated frameworks that safeguard quality and accelerate deployments.
SQL & Data Querying: Crafting optimized queries to extract insights and audit data integrity.
AI Integration: Leveraging AI tools to speed up workflows and scale problem-solving.

📩 Open to networking, collaboration, and new opportunities.
